responsibility: Declares the Memory Flow Controller I/O programming interface used by SPU software for DMA and channel operations. It defines DMA list element structures, transfer-size limits, command encodings and modifiers, macros that compose MFC command words and issue DMA/get/put/list/signal/synchronization operations via SPU intrinsics, status/query helpers for channels and tags, interrupt-safe critical-section helpers, and external tag manager functions, serving as the runtime header for SPU memory-transfer and mailbox control code.
